trend: UK Biobank study (reported 17 Nov): coffee's link to lower Parkinson's risk showed up mainly in fast caffeine metabolisers
why: Uses a fresh coffee study to land the sleep point (caffeine lingers), with the observational caveat up front. No product named.
text:
A new UK Biobank study found coffee's link to lower Parkinson's risk showed up mainly in people who clear caffeine fast.

It's observational. The everyday lesson is about sleep: caffeine lingers around 5 hours, longer if you clear it slowly.

What time is your last cup?
